response.sql:
SELECT f.orderslink, o.mktnote, AVG(f.rebrate) AS average_maker_rebate_rate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS total_rebate
FROM fees AS f
JOIN orders AS o
  ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009
GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote
ORDER BY total_rebate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Interprets “with 0.0009 on the fee rate as the cutoff” as including fee rates greater than or equal to 0.0009.

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff means strictly greater than 0.0009, use this filter instead.
